normalizations.places: S is a finite set of height-one primes of the number ring; archimedean places are implicit in the finite-prime S-integer convention
normalizations.curve: an affine smooth geometrically integral scheme over Spec K with dimension-one compatibility data
normalizations.completion: a smooth proper scheme over Spec K containing the affine curve, with named genus and geometric-complement compatibility predicates
normalizations.boundary: a finite set of geometric boundary points; positive genus or genus zero with cardinality at least three
normalizations.integrality: all coordinates in a frozen affine embedding lie in mathlib's S-integer subalgebra
normalizations.finiteness: Set.Finite on the subtype of rational section points satisfying the integral-coordinate predicate

excluded_variants: genus zero with fewer than three geometric boundary points
singular, reducible, non-affine, or non-dimension-one objects
effective bounds, enumeration, uniformity, or independence from the chosen model

status_boundary.source_fidelity: H3: the intake's primary-source pinpoint and reviewed assumption map remain open
status_boundary.machine: M3: the exact selected proposition elaborates; no terminal proof body is claimed
status_boundary.readability: R3: the encoding is documented but independently unreviewed
